end.parentNote: Asha practised BCE/CE timeline order and judging historical sources with Aarav. Aarav first mixed up the order of BCE dates, then corrected it in the later sequence. At home, practise placing a few BCE and CE dates on a hand-drawn timeline and discuss what one source might leave out.
